required_documents.name: Passport
required_documents.description: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity beyond intended stay
validation_rules: Must be valid for at least 6 months beyond intended stay
Must have at least 2 blank pages

required_documents.name: DS-160 Confirmation
required_documents.description: Confirmation page of DS-160 online application
validation_rules: Must be complete and submitted online

required_documents.name: Photo
required_documents.description: 2x2 inch color photo meeting US visa requirements

required_documents.name: Appointment Confirmation
validation_rules: Must show appointment date and time

required_documents.name: Financial Documents
required_documents.description: Proof of sufficient funds for stay in USA
validation_rules: Or proof of employment and income

required_documents.name: Travel Itinerary
required_documents.description: Details of planned travel to USA

required_documents.name: Ties to Home Country
required_documents.description: Evidence of strong ties to home country
